noise_floor.note: exactly zero on three byte-identical repeats, so every difference below is real rather than run-to-run variation.

HEADLINE: THE ORDERING FROM THE LENGTH-39 RUN DOES NOT REPRODUCE, AND IT INVERTED. At 39 frames (Sol inert, pre-rewrite prompt, 1344x768) the order was u8 0.458 < u4 0.531 < opt4 0.552. Here it is opt4 0.523 < mix6 0.536 < u4 0.537 < u8 0.542 -- the best and worst arms have swapped ends. The spread also collapsed, from about 0.094 to 0.019 on a base of 0.52. The 2026-08-28 handoff and h3_pdd.md both said the length-39 ORDERING survived its supersession because every arm shared prompt, length, canvas, seed and Sol state. That reasoning was wrong: a shared confound cannot flip an ordering WITHIN a run, but the ordering is not a property of the partitions alone -- it is a property of the partitions at a length, canvas and prompt, and it did not survive changing them.

predictions_scored.1_mix6_between_u8_and_u4: REFUTED. mix6 0.53634 is below BOTH u4 0.53709 and u8 0.54198, i.e. closer to the reference than either. This was the outcome pre-registered as 'more interesting than it holding'.
predictions_scored.3_opt4_still_worse_than_uniform: REFUTED, and reversed: opt4 is the CLOSEST arm here. The [28,2,1,1] refutation recorded on 2026-08-28 was a length-39 result and does not hold at 362.
predictions_scored.4_audio_about_2x_video: WEAKENED. Audio 0.858-0.992 against video 0.523-0.542 is about 1.7x, not 2x, and audio does not order with video: u8 has the BEST audio and the WORST video.

what_this_does_NOT_license: It does not say opt4 is the best partition. The spread is 0.019 on a base of 0.52 -- about 4% -- from ONE seed at ONE length on ONE canvas with ONE prompt. The zero floor makes the differences real, not important.

Every arm sits 0.52-0.54 from the reference with max|d| = 1.0, which is the different-sample regime CLAUDE.md describes rather than a degraded-version-of-the-same-sample regime. Read that as: at production settings this metric does not separate these partitions, rather than as a ranking with a new winner.
Nothing here is perceptual. Distance to the distilled trajectory is not quality, and no clip was judged.
The canvas is 1152x768, not the 1344x768 that ships.
